description: An abstract class providing a generic implementation of the IndelUpdate interface, supporting insert, delete, and replace-all operations for data updates.

classes.name: AbstractIndelUpdate
classes.description: An abstract class implementing indel update operations with sets for inserts and deletes, supporting reset, insert, delete, and equality checks.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the inserts and deletes to empty sets and sets replaceAll to false.

methods.name: getInserts
methods.description: Returns the set of items to be inserted.

methods.name: getDeletes
methods.description: Returns the set of items to be deleted.

methods.name: shouldReplaceAll
methods.description: Indicates whether this update is a replace-all operation.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Adds an item to the inserts set and removes it from deletes if present.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Adds an item to the deletes set and removes it from inserts if present.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on inserts, deletes, and replaceAll flag.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on inserts, deletes, and replaceAll.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.

search-terms: Java abstract class for indel updates
